title: QA Lead
summary: A QA lead (quality assurance lead) owns testing for a product or release: planning what gets tested, leading a team of manual and automation testers, and saying whether a release is ready to ship. They sit in the QA or engineering team and report quality risks to product and engineering leads.
dailyDuties: Write the test strategy and test plan for each release
Estimate test effort and assign work to testers
Run defect triage meetings with developers and product owners
Review test cases and automation code written by the team
Track regression runs in the CI pipeline and chase flaky tests
Share test status and give go/no-go input before each release
Coach junior testers on test design and tools

skills.expectation: Write the test strategy, test plan and effort estimates for each release

Guide the team's UI automation framework and review automation code
Guide the team's UI automation framework and review automation code
Test and automate REST APIs with Postman or Rest Assured
Run defect triage and track defects to closure in Jira or a similar tool
Plan testing inside sprints with developers and product owners
Give go/no-go input on releases and report quality risks to product and engineering leads
Write clear test status and release quality reports
Do exploratory and functional testing alongside the team
Run automated regression suites in the CI pipeline
Plan load tests with JMeter or similar tools
Validate data in the database with SQL
Coordinate user acceptance testing with business users
